marking_points.criterion: Initializes best with the first complete row total or with an unset marker; a single element is not a safe row-total bound.
Traverses every row with its index.
Resets row total before each row.
Accumulates every element in that row.
On a new minimum updates best and resets index list to the current row.
On a tie appends current index without discarding earlier ties.
Returns best and all correct indices after traversal.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: Executable checks saved under checks/ where applicable.
